{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:06:43.252160Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:06:43.251954Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:06:44.903741Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:06:44.903129Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:06:44.909064Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:06:44.908753Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.631232Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.630286Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.634643Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.634082Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.642293Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.641528Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.648598Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.645274Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.676688Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.673516Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.983\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.982\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     867.6\n",
      "Date:                Fri, 27 Nov 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           1.78e-40\n",
      "Time:                        21:06:48   Log-Likelihood:                -1.7648\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                             11.53\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                             19.18\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          4.9852      0.089     55.966      0.000       4.806       5.164\n",
      "x1             0.4969      0.014     36.173      0.000       0.469       0.525\n",
      "x2             0.5368      0.054      9.941      0.000       0.428       0.646\n",
      "x3            -0.0187      0.001    -15.535      0.000      -0.021      -0.016\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        1.655   Durbin-Watson:                   1.947\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.437   Jarque-Bera (JB):                1.529\n",
      "Skew:                          -0.410   Prob(JB):                        0.466\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       2.755   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.680275Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.680051Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.688953Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.688456Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.51670369  5.00597233  5.45398875  5.83149596  6.11979566  6.31382032\n",
      "  6.42296578  6.46954751  6.48513426  6.50536139  6.56407612  6.68777646\n",
      "  6.89125774  7.17518169  7.52596783  7.91802458  8.317954    8.6900389\n",
      "  9.0021111   9.23083657  9.36554914  9.41000293  9.38175557  9.30928348\n",
      "  9.22730334  9.1710682   9.1705755   9.2456386   9.40263148  9.63344154\n",
      "  9.91680242 10.22178809 10.51289381 10.75586955 10.92334711 10.99933667\n",
      " 10.98185384 10.88324575 10.72816237 10.54950666 10.38302868 10.26145193\n",
      " 10.20909703 10.23788586 10.34538284 10.51519511 10.71966582 10.92441805\n",
      " 11.09400287 11.19772349]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.691362Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.691104Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.697822Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.697165Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[11.20546498 11.07281844 10.82083649 10.49749535 10.16594864  9.88906512\n",
      "  9.71403625  9.66082209  9.71726435  9.84206316]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.701370Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:06:48.701126Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.160033Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.159521Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x799cdc33c1a0>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.170967Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.170747Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.184669Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.184030Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.193953Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.193741Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.204056Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.203455Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           4.985151\n",
       "x1                  0.496925\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.536834\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.018738\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.214247Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.214030Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.225277Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:06:49.224473Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    11.205465\n",
       "1    11.072818\n",
       "2    10.820836\n",
       "3    10.497495\n",
       "4    10.165949\n",
       "5     9.889065\n",
       "6     9.714036\n",
       "7     9.660822\n",
       "8     9.717264\n",
       "9     9.842063\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
